name: Bhavyy Khurana
project_details: Built an LLM-powered portfolio assistant using FastAPI and OpenAI’s GPT-OSS; designed a ReAct-style agent with custom tools for job description extraction and automated candidate-job matching (Portfolio AI Live).

Built an acquisition-robust lung‑nodule detection pipeline combining physics‑simulated CT augmentation, an anisotropy‑conditioned 3D Swin Transformer encoder, and a cross‑acquisition consistency‑distillation loss; validated a thinning‑induced detection reduction (5 mm CPM reduction from 33.1% to 21.6%) without loss of baseline detection capability (Acquisition Robust Network).

Developed a CUDA‑accelerated stereo depth pipeline using Census transform, 8‑path Semi‑Global Matching and winner‑takes‑all disparity selection; implemented six custom CUDA stages with shared memory, parallel min‑reduction, and GPU global‑memory pipelines, processing KITTI Stereo 2015 pairs without CPU intervention, achieving 7.1% Bad 3.0 error, 1.78 px MAE, and 168.5 ms median processing time across 200 scenes (~30× speedup over CPU baseline) (CUDA Stereo Depth Estimation).

Developed AHM‑DPF, a feedback‑driven Hopfield architecture with adaptive memory updates and selective forgetting to mitigate catastrophic interference; evaluated variants on a BitPatternSet benchmark, achieving 99.8% accuracy in the 64‑D setting and 87.3% in the 8‑D setting, outperforming non‑adaptive variants by 25‑33 percentage points (Adaptive Hopfield Memory with Dynamic Pattern Forgetting).

Created a two‑stage network intrusion anomaly detection system using supervised models for known threats and unsupervised models for zero‑day detection on the UNSW‑NB15 dataset; achieved 99.47% accuracy with Random Forest for known threats and ROC‑AUC 0.858 with Isolation Forest for zero‑day detection (Network Intrusion Anomaly Detection System).
education: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering – Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, Manipal Institute of Technology, Manipal, Karnataka (2023 – 2027)
certifications: Big Data Specialization – University of California San Diego
internship_details: Data and Analytics Intern at Lepton Software (2026): Built a sub‑hourly rainfall nowcasting and traffic‑impact pipeline integrating spateGAN and multi‑quantile regression models to forecast road‑level traffic disruption; engineered a geospatial data layer by integrating ERA5 reanalysis, Google Weather API and H3 spatial indexing for operational road‑impact forecasting across Pune and Kolkata; back‑tested over 59,000 road‑hour predictions, reducing speed error by 18‑63% versus climatological baselines.
